meta.name: Sealed Signal
meta.description: Two players make private decisions based on a shared die.
rules.goal: Both players have 20 seconds. Claim scores the die if the other player does not claim it. Yield scores one point. A missing choice scores zero.
event.committed: A player made a sealed decision
event.timeout: Time expired and the decisions were revealed
clock.label: Decision time
release.current: Demonstrates private decisions and a deadline.
